mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trigger_event (id, platform, bot_id, group_id, trigger_kind, event_type, dedup_key, digest, source_ref, decision, decision_layer, decision_reason, batch_digest, turn_id, occurred_at, decided_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{platform}, #{botId}, #{groupId}, #{triggerKind}, #{eventType}, #{dedupKey}, #{digest}, #{sourceRef}, #{decision}, #{decisionLayer}, #{decisionReason}, #{batchDigest}, #{turnId}, #{occurredAt}, #{decidedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, trigger_kind AS triggerKind, event_type AS eventType, dedup_key AS dedupKey, digest, source_ref AS sourceRef, decision, decision_layer AS decisionLayer, decision_reason AS decisionReason, batch_digest AS batchDigest, turn_id AS turnId, occurred_at AS occurredAt, decided_at AS decidedAt FROM trigger_event WHERE platform = #{platform} AND bot_id = #{botId} AND dedup_key = #{dedupKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE trigger_event SET decision = #{decision}, decision_layer = #{decisionLayer}, decision_reason = #{decisionReason}, batch_digest = #{batchDigest}, decided_at = #{decidedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, trigger_kind AS triggerKind, event_type AS eventType, dedup_key AS dedupKey, digest, source_ref AS sourceRef, decision, decision_layer AS decisionLayer, decision_reason AS decisionReason, batch_digest AS batchDigest, turn_id AS turnId, occurred_at AS occurredAt, decided_at AS decidedAt FROM trigger_event WHERE platform = #{platform} AND bot_id = #{botId} AND group_id = #{groupId} AND decision = 'pending' ORDER BY occurred_at
